item.tib: ma rgyud kyi mchod pa bcu drug pa'i 'phrin las dga' dbang gter gyi tshom bu
item.coloph: gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod pa bcu drug pa 'bul ba dga' dbang gter gyi tshom bu zhes bya ba/ dmu rigs rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis rta sgo lha brtsen (btsan) gyi mdun ri khrod pa chen po bzhugs pa'i gnas mdun bar zlum nyid du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
